# Dictionary and Language Library

Welcome to the on-line _Dictionary and Language Library,_ which is being developed by Foras na Gaeilge in parallel with the _New English-Irish Dictionary_ project. The aim of the site is to provide users of the language with free, easy-to-use access to dictionaries and to grammatical and pronunciation information relating to words in the Irish Language. [Further information...](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/_about)

## On this site

- [Foclóir Gaeilge–Béarla (Ó Dónaill, 1977) »A searchable electronic version of Ó Dónaill’s Irish-English dictionary](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/fgb/)
- [An Foclóir Beag (Ó Dónaill & Ua Maoileoin, 1991) »A searchable electronic version of an Irish-Irish dictionary](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/fb/)
- [English–Irish Dictionary (de Bhaldraithe, 1959) »A searchable electronic version of de Bhaldraithe’s English-Irish dictionary](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/eid/)
- [Grammar Database »Inflected forms of Irish nouns, verbs, adjectives etc.](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/gram/)
- [Pronunciation Database »Sound files for Irish words in the three major dialects](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/fuaim/)

## Feedback

All feedback on the site is very welcome. Further information available [here](https://www.teanglann.ie/en/_feedback).
